subject: Audit surface & log granularity — HealthGrid asks (triage)
messages:
From: Frank Li <frank.li@healthgrid.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: healthgrid-security@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-06-01T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on audit logs / retention / KMS alignment

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the intro. A few priority asks from our security ops and infra teams (summarized):

1) Per-tenant raw audit stream: we need raw events (not just daily aggregates) tagged by tenant_id with sub-second timestamps; retention policy configurable per-tenant (30d, 365d, or archive).
2) Proof of retention deletion: ability to generate a signed proof that events were purged at retention expiry.
3) BYOK rotation window alignment: our key rotation policy is 90 days with overlap; can Redwood support custom KMS rotation windows (including HSM-backed keys)?
4) SSO provisioning audit logs: show identity provisioning events (create/disable/scim sync) with actor and IP.

I've attached a spreadsheet with examples and row-level samples. Can you triage with your team and let us know scope/ETA and what will require an exception?

-Frank
Frank Li
Head of Security Operations
HealthGrid

Attachment: healthgrid-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: frank.li@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit surface & log granularity — HealthGrid asks (triage)

Team — looping you in on HealthGrid's security asks (see Frank's note below). High-level request: map out what is product vs. short-term exception, estimate effort, and call out any blockers (KMS, retention proofing, SSO event surface).

Specific asks:
- Which of these are doable within current roadmap (existing audit pipeline + per-tenant tags)?
- Which need infra work (streaming, per-tenant retention windows, signed purge proofs)?
- What would BYOK/HSM rotation support look like and what constraints (HSM provider, overlap windows)?

Attachments: audit-surface-proposal.pdf (outline/proposed approach), healthgrid-questions.xlsx (from customer).

Goal: get back to HealthGrid with triage and an initial timeline by end of day tomorrow (6/2).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit surface & log granularity — HealthGrid asks (triage)

Ben — quick initial triage from security's perspective:

- Per-tenant raw stream: product currently retains raw events for 90 days in our eventstore but we only surface aggregated metrics in the Console. Exposing raw, tenant-tagged events requires (a) tagging at ingestion, (b) a retention policy per tenant, and (c) query/export endpoints. Effort: small spike (1–2 weeks) + engineering work (3–4 weeks) to expose APIs and controls.

- Signed deletion proofs: we can prototype HMAC-signed deletion manifests (proof-of-purge) in ~2 weeks as a service layer feature; cryptographic attestation with an HSM will add significant compliance review and infra changes.

- BYOK rotation: current KMS integration is flexible but assumes provider-managed rotation. Supporting customer-initiated rotations with overlap windows is possible but we'll need to validate HSM key import semantics for specific vendors. Likely 3–6 week effort depending on vendor complexity.

- SSO provisioning events: identity service already logs SCIM sync events. We need to add actor/IP to retained logs for 1 year by default; effort small (1 week).

I added a short note in the Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D5E and created SUP-1234 to track the spike.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit surface & log granularity — HealthGrid asks (triage)

Adding infra/product perspective:

- Ingestion tagging: architecturally straightforward if we add tenant_id metadata at the edge. We need to confirm throughput implications for our eventstore (HealthGrid expects sub-second timestamps and high-cardinality tags). Suggest a 2-week spike to validate indexing and cost.

- Retention per tenant: current storage tiering supports policy-based TTL, but per-tenant exceptions will require a small policy engine + UI to manage exceptions. Surface area: API, console, billing (cost attribution). Estimated work: 3–5 sprints (team dependent).

- Signed purge proofs: if we provide HMAC manifests generated at purge time we can deliver quickly; if HealthGrid requires an HSM-signed certificate we need vendor onboarding — that's the blocker.

- BYOK/HSM rotations: ask HealthGrid to share the HSM vendor and rotation mechanics (import/export, key IDs, rotation overlap). If they use a supported cloud KMS (AWS KMS/GCP KMS) we can map to current flow; custom HSMs add ~4 weeks.

I'll draft a short scope doc and link it to SUP-1234. Marcus.

Attachment: audit-surface-proposal.pdf (design sketch)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: frank.li@healthgrid.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit surface & log granularity — HealthGrid asks (triage)

Thanks all — collating next steps for HealthGrid: 

1) Marcus/Engineering to run a 2-week spike to validate tenant tagging and eventstore indexing (owner: marcus_lin).
2) Grace/Security to prototype HMAC-based deletion manifests for quick proof-of-purge and outline HSM-attestation path (owner: grace_oconnor).
3) Product to scope per-tenant retention UI + billing impact (owner: neha_kapoor).
4) Ben to gather HealthGrid HSM/KMS vendor details and rotation docs from Frank by EOD 6/3.

Frank — can you confirm the HSM vendor and attach any key rotation docs (or confirm if this is AWS KMS/GCP KMS)? Also, please confirm if HealthGrid needs signed HSM attestations or if an HMAC manifest suffices for now.

We'll publish SUP-1234 with the spike plan and share a short timeline once Marcus finishes the spike.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
